What this part coversApa yang bahagian ini liputi

Heat transfer had one unknown per node; plane stress has two, the displacements u and v. The governing equation needs three ingredients instead of two: equilibrium of a small element, Hooke’s law, and the relation between strains and displacements. Together they give the same pattern as heat transfer, [∂][E][∂]ᵀ{u}ᵀ = −{f}, with bigger matrices. This part also sets up the boundary conditions and the shape-function matrix [N]; Part 2 builds [k] and solves the cantilever, and Part 3 recovers the stresses.Heat transfer ada satu unknown setiap node; plane stress ada dua, iaitu displacement u dan v. Persamaan pentadbir memerlukan tiga bahan, bukan dua: equilibrium bagi element kecil, Hooke’s law, dan hubungan antara strain dan displacement. Bersama-sama ia memberi pola yang sama dengan heat transfer, [∂][E][∂]ᵀ{u}ᵀ = −{f}, dengan matrix yang lebih besar. Bahagian ini juga menyediakan boundary condition dan shape-function matrix [N]; Part 2 membina [k] dan menyelesaikan cantilever, dan Part 3 mendapatkan semula stress.

  3. Classify traction (natural) and displacement (essential) boundary conditions in each direction and write them for a rectangular domain.Mengelaskan boundary condition traction (natural) dan displacement (essential) dalam setiap arah dan menulisnya untuk rectangular domain.

1. Why plane stress: two unknowns at every pointMengapa plane stress: dua unknown pada setiap titik

≈ 7 min

Heat transfer gave a scalar field: one temperature at every point and one unknown at every node. Plane stress gives a vector field: every point of a plate moves by a displacement with two components, u(x, y) along x and v(x, y) along y. From the displacements we get strains, and from the strains stresses. The finite element method solves for u and v at the nodes; strains and stresses come afterwards, by differentiation.Heat transfer memberi scalar field: satu temperature pada setiap titik dan satu unknown pada setiap node. Plane stress memberi vector field: setiap titik plat bergerak dengan displacement yang ada dua komponen, u(x, y) dalam arah x dan v(x, y) dalam arah y. Daripada displacement kita dapat strain, dan daripada strain kita dapat stress. Finite element method menyelesaikan u dan v pada node; strain dan stress dikira kemudian, melalui pembezaan.

Plane stress and plane strainPlane stress dan plane strainPlane stress: the body is thin (thickness t small) and loaded only in its own plane, so its faces are free: σzz = σxz = σyz = 0, while the plate may thin or thicken (εzz ≠ 0). Plane strain: the body is long in z and every section is loaded alike, so each slice is held by its neighbours: εzz = 0, and a stress σzz = ν(σxx + σyy) develops to keep it so.Plane stress: badan itu nipis (ketebalan t kecil) dan dibebankan hanya dalam satahnya sendiri, jadi mukanya bebas: σzz = σxz = σyz = 0, manakala plat boleh menipis atau menebal (εzz ≠ 0). Plane strain: badan itu panjang dalam arah z dan setiap keratan dibebankan sama, jadi setiap kepingan ditahan oleh jirannya: εzz = 0, dan stress σzz = ν(σxx + σyy) terbentuk untuk mengekalkannya.

A slab carrying a floor load is neither: the load acts normal to its plane, so it bends as a plate, a different problem. The test for plane stress is always the same two questions: is the body thin compared with its in-plane size, and do the loads act in its plane?Slab yang menanggung beban lantai bukan kedua-duanya: beban bertindak normal kepada satahnya, jadi ia melentur sebagai plate, masalah yang berbeza. Ujian untuk plane stress sentiasa dua soalan yang sama: adakah badan itu nipis berbanding saiz dalam satahnya, dan adakah beban bertindak dalam satahnya?

Displacement-based FEMFEM berasaskan displacementWe solve for u and v and differentiate them to get strains and stresses. Each differentiation costs accuracy, so stresses are always less accurate than displacements, and they jump between elements. Part 3 is about exactly that.Kita selesaikan u dan v dan bezakannya untuk mendapatkan strain dan stress. A concrete gravity dam 300 m long carries water pressure that is the same at every section. Which idealisation, and which quantity is zero?Empangan graviti konkrit sepanjang 300 m menanggung tekanan air yang sama pada setiap keratan. Idealisation yang mana, dan kuantiti apa yang sifar?

The dam is long and every section is loaded alike, so each slice is held by its neighbours and cannot strain along the axis: εzz = 0. A stress σzz develops instead.Empangan itu panjang dan setiap keratan dibebankan sama, jadi setiap kepingan ditahan oleh jirannya dan tidak boleh ber-strain di sepanjang paksinya: εzz = 0. 2. Equilibrium of a differential elementEquilibrium bagi differential element

≈ 10 min

Take a small rectangle dx by dy of unit thickness inside the plate. On its faces act the normal stresses σxx and σyy and the shear stresses σxy and σyx (N m−2); inside acts a body force fx, fy per unit volume (N m−3), for example self-weight fy = −ρg. The method is the one used for the heat flux in Heat Transfer Part 1: the stress on a far face is the near-face stress plus its first-order change.Ambil satu segi empat kecil dx × dy dengan ketebalan unit di dalam plat. Pada mukanya bertindak normal stress σxx dan σyy serta shear stress σxy dan σyx (N m−2); di dalamnya bertindak body force fx, fy per unit isi padu (N m−3), contohnya berat sendiri fy = −ρg. Kaedahnya sama seperti heat flux dalam Heat Transfer Part 1: stress pada muka jauh ialah stress muka dekat ditambah perubahan first-order-nya.

Sign conventionKonvensyen tandaA stress component is positive when it acts in the positive coordinate direction on a face whose outward normal points in a positive direction, and in the negative direction on a face whose outward normal is negative.Satu komponen stress positif apabila ia bertindak dalam arah koordinat positif pada muka yang outward normal-nya menghala ke arah positif, dan dalam arah negatif pada muka yang outward normal-nya negatif.

Force balance in xKeseimbangan daya dalam arah x

Static equilibrium requires the forces in x and in y to sum to zero. Forces are stresses times face areas: σxx acts on the faces of area dy, σyx on the faces of area dx (each times the unit thickness):Static equilibrium memerlukan jumlah daya dalam arah x dan y bersamaan sifar. Daya ialah stress didarab luas muka: σxx bertindak pada muka seluas dy, σyx pada muka seluas dx (setiap satu didarab ketebalan unit):

(3.1), (3.2)
(3.3)

The near-face terms cancel against the first part of the far-face terms, every remaining term carries dx dy, and dividing by it leaves the first equilibrium equation:Term muka dekat terbatal dengan bahagian pertama term muka jauh, setiap term yang tinggal membawa dx dy, dan membahagi dengannya meninggalkan equilibrium equation pertama:

(3.4)
Unit checkSemakan unitA stress gradient is (N m−2)/m = N m−3, a force per unit volume, the same as the body force.Stress gradient ialah (N m−2)/m = N m−3, daya per unit isi padu, sama dengan body force.

Force balance in y (Activity 2)Keseimbangan daya dalam arah y (Aktiviti 2)

In y, σyy acts on the faces of area dx and σxy on the faces of area dy. The same expansion givesDalam arah y, σyy bertindak pada muka seluas dx dan σxy pada muka seluas dy. Pengembangan yang sama memberi

(3.5)
(3.6)
Why σyx = σxyMengapa σyx = σxyTake moments about the centre of the element: the pair σxy dy on the x-faces and the pair σyx dx on the y-faces each make a couple with arm dx or dy. Equilibrium of moments makes the two couples equal, σxy dy dx = σyx dx dy, so the shear stresses are equal. Only three stress components remain.Ambil momen terhadap pusat element: pasangan σxy dy pada muka-x dan pasangan σyx dx pada muka-y masing-masing membentuk couple dengan lengan dx atau dy. Keseimbangan momen menjadikan dua couple itu sama, σxy dy dx = σyx dx dy, jadi shear stress itu sama. Hanya tiga komponen stress tinggal.

The matrix formBentuk matrix

Collect the two equations with a 2 × 3 matrix of derivative operators acting on the stress vector {σxx σyy σxy}ᵀ. This is the plane-stress version of {∂}{q} in heat transfer: there a 1 × 2 row acted on a 2 × 1 flux; here a 2 × 3 matrix acts on a 3 × 1 stress.Kumpulkan dua persamaan itu dengan matrix 2 × 3 bagi derivative operator yang bertindak ke atas stress vector {σxx σyy σxy}ᵀ. Ini versi plane stress bagi {∂}{q} dalam heat transfer: di sana satu baris 1 × 2 bertindak ke atas flux 2 × 1; di sini matrix 2 × 3 bertindak ke atas stress 3 × 1.

(3.8)
(3.9)

Worked step · Activity 2 in wordsLangkah bekerja · Aktiviti 2 dalam ayat

Forces in y: σyy on the bottom face (area dx) acts downward, σyy + ∂σyy/∂y dy on the top face acts upward; σxy on the left face (area dy) acts downward, σxy + ∂σxy/∂x dx on the right face acts upward; fy dx dy acts on the volume. Sum, cancel, divide by dx dy: ∂σxy/∂x + ∂σyy/∂y + fy = 0. Row 2 of [∂] is therefore [0 ∂/∂y ∂/∂x].Daya dalam arah y: σyy pada muka bawah (luas dx) bertindak ke bawah, σyy + ∂σyy/∂y dy pada muka atas bertindak ke atas; σxy pada muka kiri (luas dy) bertindak ke bawah, σxy + ∂σxy/∂x dx pada muka kanan bertindak ke atas; fy dx dy bertindak pada isi padu. Jumlahkan, batalkan, bahagi dengan dx dy: ∂σxy/∂x + ∂σyy/∂y + fy = 0. Jadi baris 2 bagi [∂] ialah [0 ∂/∂y ∂/∂x].

  • Force balance in x and y on dx × dy gives (3.4) and (3.6); moment balance gives σyx = σxy.Keseimbangan daya dalam x dan y pada dx × dy memberi (3.4) dan (3.6); keseimbangan momen memberi σyx = σxy.
  • Matrix form [∂]{σ}ᵀ = −{f} with the 2 × 3 operator [∂].Bentuk matrix [∂]{σ}ᵀ = −{f} dengan operator [∂] 2 × 3.
  • Every term is a force per unit volume, N m−3.Setiap term ialah daya per unit isi padu, N m−3.

3. Hooke’s law: plane stress and plane strainHooke’s law: plane stress dan plane strain

≈ 8 min

Equilibrium gives two equations in three unknown stresses. Hooke’s law, the analogue of Fourier’s law, relates the stresses to the strains through the material. For plane stress (σzz = 0) it readsEquilibrium memberi dua persamaan dalam tiga stress yang tidak diketahui. Hooke’s law, analog bagi Fourier’s law, menghubungkan stress dengan strain melalui bahan. Untuk plane stress (σzz = 0) ia berbunyi

(3.10)

or, with the 3 × 3 constitutive matrix [E],atau, dengan constitutive matrix [E] 3 × 3,

(3.11), (3.12)
Engineering shear strainEngineering shear strainThe text’s εxy is the engineering shear strain, εxy = ∂u/∂y + ∂v/∂x (written γxy in most solid-mechanics books), not the tensor strain, which is half of it. The (3,3) entry of [E] is built for it: (E/(1 − ν²))·(1 − ν)/2 = E/(2(1 + ν)) = G, the shear modulus.εxy dalam teks ialah engineering shear strain, εxy = ∂u/∂y + ∂v/∂x (ditulis γxy dalam kebanyakan buku mekanik pepejal), bukan tensor strain, yang separuh daripadanya. Entri (3,3) bagi [E] dibina untuknya: (E/(1 − ν²))·(1 − ν)/2 = E/(2(1 + ν)) = G, iaitu shear modulus.

The cantilever’s material (Activity 3)Bahan cantilever (Aktiviti 3)

For the text’s cantilever, E = 200 × 10⁶ N m−2 and ν = 0.33. Keep four significant figures: Part 2 builds [k] from these numbers.Untuk cantilever dalam teks, E = 200 × 10⁶ N m−2 dan ν = 0.33. Simpan empat angka bererti: Part 2 membina [k] daripada nombor ini.

CheckSemakanG = E/(2(1 + ν)) = 200 × 10⁶/2.66 = 75.19 × 10⁶ N m−2, equal to the (3,3) entry. If your (3,3) entry is twice this, you used (1 − ν) instead of (1 − ν)/2.G = E/(2(1 + ν)) = 200 × 10⁶/2.66 = 75.19 × 10⁶ N m−2, sama dengan entri (3,3). Jika entri (3,3) anda dua kali ganda nilai ini, anda telah guna (1 − ν) dan bukan (1 − ν)/2.

Plane strain changes only [E]Plane strain hanya mengubah [E]

Setting εzz = 0 instead of σzz = 0 in three-dimensional Hooke’s law gives a matrix with the same shape and different constants:Menetapkan εzz = 0 dan bukan σzz = 0 dalam Hooke’s law tiga dimensi memberi matrix dengan bentuk yang sama tetapi pemalar yang berbeza:

The shear entry is G in both. The normal entries are larger in plane strain, because a slice that cannot thin resists in-plane stretching more. For ν = 0.33 the bending stiffness of the cantilever rises by the factor 1/(1 − ν²) = 1.12, so its tip deflection falls to about 0.89 of the plane-stress value; the Explorer shows 0.90 on a fine mesh. As ν approaches 0.5 (rubber, undrained clay) the plane-strain constants grow without bound: the material becomes incompressible, a topic for later courses.Entri shear ialah G dalam kedua-duanya. Entri normal lebih besar dalam plane strain, kerana kepingan yang tidak boleh menipis lebih menahan regangan dalam satah. Untuk ν = 0.33, bending stiffness cantilever meningkat dengan faktor 1/(1 − ν²) = 1.12, jadi tip deflection-nya turun kepada kira-kira 0.89 daripada nilai plane stress; Explorer menunjukkan 0.90 pada mesh halus. Apabila ν menghampiri 0.5 (getah, undrained clay), pemalar plane strain membesar tanpa had: bahan itu menjadi incompressible, topik untuk kursus kemudian.

In this courseDalam kursus iniWe formulate and calculate by hand in plane stress (text Chapter 3). Plane strain is the same [k] with the other [E]: one line in the code, one option in ANSYS.Kita memformulasi dan mengira dengan tangan dalam plane stress (teks Bab 3). Plane strain ialah [k] yang sama dengan [E] yang lain: satu baris dalam kod, satu pilihan dalam ANSYS.

  • εxy is the engineering shear strain; the (3,3) entry equals G.εxy ialah engineering shear strain; entri (3,3) sama dengan G.

(1 − ν)/2 × E/(1 − ν²) = 0.335 × 224.44 × 10⁶ = 75.19 × 10⁶ = G. Option (a) forgets the half; (c) is the (1,2) entry, ν E/(1 − ν²).(1 − ν)/2 × E/(1 − ν²) = 0.335 × 224.44 × 10⁶ = 75.19 × 10⁶ = G. Pilihan (a) terlupa separuh; (c) ialah entri (1,2), ν E/(1 − ν²).

4. Strain–displacement, and the PDE in u and vStrain–displacement, dan PDE dalam u dan v

≈ 7 min

Heat transfer had no step like this one, because T was itself the unknown. Here the unknowns are displacements, and the strains are their derivatives: εxx measures stretching along x, εyy along y, and εxy the change of a right angle.Heat transfer tiada langkah seperti ini, kerana T sendiri ialah unknown. Di sini unknown ialah displacement, dan strain ialah derivative-nya: εxx mengukur regangan dalam arah x, εyy dalam arah y, dan εxy perubahan sudut tegak.

(3.13)

In matrix form the 3 × 2 operator is exactly the transpose of the equilibrium operator [∂]. That is not a coincidence: equilibrium and compatibility are dual, and it is why the final matrix [k] comes out symmetric.Dalam bentuk matrix, operator 3 × 2 itu tepat transpose bagi equilibrium operator [∂]. Itu bukan kebetulan: equilibrium dan compatibility adalah dual, dan itulah sebab matrix akhir [k] keluar simetri.

(3.14), (3.15)
The factor that loses marksFaktor yang menghilangkan markahεxy = ∂u/∂y + ∂v/∂x, the sum of the two slopes. Halving it, or using the tensor shear strain with the text’s [E], halves the shear stress.εxy = ∂u/∂y + ∂v/∂x, hasil tambah dua cerun. Membahagi dua nilainya, atau menggunakan tensor shear strain dengan [E] dalam teks, menjadikan shear stress separuh.

Assemble the PDEBina PDE

Substitute the strains into Hooke’s law and Hooke’s law into equilibrium. The result is two PDEs in the two displacements, written once with the three matrices:Gantikan strain ke dalam Hooke’s law dan Hooke’s law ke dalam equilibrium. Hasilnya dua PDE dalam dua displacement, ditulis sekali dengan tiga matrix:

(3.16)
(3.17)

Read (3.17) from the inside out: [∂]ᵀ{u}ᵀ turns displacements into strains (3 × 1); [E] turns strains into stresses (3 × 1); [∂] turns stresses into the two equilibrium equations, balanced by the body force. Compare it with the heat PDE:Baca (3.17) dari dalam ke luar: [∂]ᵀ{u}ᵀ menukar displacement kepada strain (3 × 1); [E] menukar strain kepada stress (3 × 1); [∂] menukar stress kepada dua equilibrium equation, diimbangi oleh body force. Bandingkan dengan PDE heat:

Same pattern, bigger matricesPola yang sama, matrix lebih besarPart 2 does with (3.17) exactly what Heat Transfer Part 2 did with (2.13): substitute {u}ᵀ = [N]{û}ᵀ, weight with [N]ᵀ (Galerkin), integrate by parts. The boundary term that appears is the traction of §5.Part 2 membuat dengan (3.17) tepat apa yang Heat Transfer Part 2 buat dengan (2.13): gantikan {u}ᵀ = [N]{û}ᵀ, beri weight dengan [N]ᵀ (Galerkin), integrate by parts. A displacement field is u = 0.002y, v = 0. Which strains does it produce?Satu displacement field ialah u = 0.002y, v = 0. Strain apa yang dihasilkan?

εxx = ∂u/∂x = 0, εyy = ∂v/∂y = 0, εxy = ∂u/∂y + ∂v/∂x = 0.002 + 0. This is simple shear; 0.001 would be the tensor strain, which the text’s [E] does not use.εxx = ∂u/∂x = 0, εyy = ∂v/∂y = 0, εxy = ∂u/∂y + ∂v/∂x = 0.002 + 0. Ini simple shear; 0.001 ialah tensor strain, yang tidak digunakan oleh [E] dalam teks.

5. Boundary conditions: traction and displacementBoundary condition: traction dan displacement

≈ 9 min

Every point of the boundary needs one condition in x and one in y. In each direction either the force on the boundary is known or the displacement is: never both, never neither.Setiap titik pada sempadan memerlukan satu condition dalam arah x dan satu dalam arah y. Dalam setiap arah sama ada daya pada sempadan diketahui atau displacement diketahui: tidak pernah kedua-duanya, tidak pernah tiada.

Traction · naturalTraction · naturalThe traction {bx, by} is the force per unit area acting on the boundary (per unit thickness: force per unit length). With the outward normal (nx, ny) it is related to the stresses by (3.18)–(3.19). A free edge has bx = by = 0.Traction {bx, by} ialah daya per unit luas yang bertindak pada sempadan (per unit ketebalan: daya per unit panjang). Dengan outward normal (nx, ny) ia dihubungkan dengan stress melalui (3.18)–(3.19). Tepi bebas ada bx = by = 0.
(3.18a), (3.19a)

Why the supports must stop every rigid motionMengapa support mesti menghalang setiap rigid motion

A plate can translate in x, translate in y and rotate in its plane without straining at all: for a small rotation θ, u = −θy and v = θx give εxx = εyy = 0 and εxy = −θ + θ = 0. Such a motion needs no force, so [K] is singular until the supports remove all three. Holding v alone along the left edge stops the y-translation but not the x-translation, nor a rotation about a point of that edge (its points move in x, not in y); the Explorer’s “vertical only” support shows the solver refusing. Holding u alone along the edge stops x-translation and rotation but leaves the plate free to slide in y.Plat boleh translate dalam arah x, translate dalam arah y dan berputar dalam satahnya tanpa sebarang strain: untuk putaran kecil θ, u = −θy dan v = θx memberi εxx = εyy = 0 dan εxy = −θ + θ = 0. Pergerakan sebegini tidak memerlukan daya, jadi [K] singular sehingga support menghapuskan ketiga-tiganya. Menahan v sahaja di sepanjang tepi kiri menghalang translation y tetapi tidak menghalang translation x, mahupun putaran terhadap satu titik pada tepi itu (titik-titiknya bergerak dalam arah x, bukan y); support “vertical only” dalam Explorer menunjukkan solver menolak. Menahan u sahaja di sepanjang tepi itu menghalang translation x dan putaran tetapi membiarkan plat bebas menggelongsor dalam arah y.

Key pointsPerkara utama
  • Traction known → natural → load (or nothing on a free edge). Displacement known → essential → imposed.Traction diketahui → natural → beban (atau tiada pada tepi bebas). Displacement diketahui → essential → dikenakan.
  • One condition per direction at every boundary point.Satu condition setiap arah pada setiap titik sempadan.
  • Supports must remove two translations and one rotation, or [K] is singular.Support mesti menghapuskan dua translation dan satu putaran, jika tidak [K] singular.

The top edge of the cantilever carries nothing. What does the finite element model do there?Tepi atas cantilever tidak menanggung apa-apa. Apa yang model finite element buat di situ?

A free edge is a natural condition with zero traction; its boundary term is zero, so it needs no action, exactly like an insulated edge. Fixing v there would add a support the structure does not have.Tepi bebas ialah natural condition dengan traction sifar; boundary term-nya sifar, jadi ia tidak memerlukan tindakan, sama seperti tepi insulated. Menetapkan v di situ menambah support yang tiada pada struktur itu.

The element is the four-node rectangle of heat transfer, with the same shape functions N1…N4 of (2.21). The 2 × 8 shape-function matrixShape-function matrix 2 × 8

Both interpolations are one matrix product. Row 1 picks the u-dofs and row 2 the v-dofs; the zeros say that u does not depend on any v. The 8-node element gives a 2 × 16 matrix of the same pattern (3.29).Kedua-dua interpolation ialah satu hasil darab matrix. Baris 1 memilih dof-u dan baris 2 dof-v; sifar menunjukkan bahawa u tidak bergantung pada mana-mana v. 8-node element memberi matrix 2 × 16 dengan pola yang sama (3.29).

Example 1 · Displacements, strains and stresses at a pointContoh 1 · Displacement, strain dan stress pada satu titik

Exam typeJenis soalan given {d} of an element, find u, v, ε and σ at a pointUnitsUnit kN, mSourceSumber FEM by Hand, Example 9.120 marksmarkah
QuestionSoalanAn element 0.6 m by 0.4 m, with E = 200 × 10⁶ kN/m² and ν = 0.3 (plane stress), has the nodal displacements {d} = {u1, v1, …, u4, v4}ᵀ = {1, 0.1, 2, 0.1, 2, 0, 1, 0}ᵀ × 10−5 m. (a) Explain how the displacements and stresses at a point (x1, y1) of the element are obtained. (b) Calculate the stresses at the centre. (c) With u3 = 3 × 10−5 m instead, find u, v and the stresses at (0.15, 0.3) m.

Physical picture.Gambaran fizikal. Nodes 2 and 3 move 1 × 10−5 m further right than nodes 1 and 4, so the element is stretched along x by 10−5/0.6 = 1.67 × 10−5. The top moves down by 10−6 relative to the bottom: a contraction in y. Nothing shears it. Expect σxx near Eεxx ≈ 3.3 × 10³ kN/m², a little more because the element contracts in y less than a free bar would.Node 2 dan 3 bergerak 1 × 10−5 m lebih ke kanan berbanding node 1 dan 4, jadi element itu diregang dalam arah x sebanyak 10−5/0.6 = 1.67 × 10−5. Bahagian atas bergerak ke bawah 10−6 relatif kepada bahagian bawah: pengecutan dalam arah y. Tiada yang meng-shear-nya. Jangka σxx sekitar Eεxx ≈ 3.3 × 10³ kN/m², sedikit lebih kerana element itu mengecut dalam arah y kurang daripada bar bebas.

Plan. (a) local coordinates → Ni → u, v → derivatives → {ε} → {σ}; (b) the centre; (c) the point (0.15, 0.3), then the centre as a check.

Step 1 (a) The procedure(a) Prosedur[4]

Only the nodal displacements of the element that contains the point are used. Dalam Part 2, derivative dalam langkah (3) dibungkus ke dalam matrix [B], supaya {ε}ᵀ = [B]{d}.

Step 2 The derivatives of u and vDerivative bagi u dan v[2]

Differentiating u = Σ Niui with the Ni of (2.21) gives, at any local point (x, y),Membezakan u = Σ Niui dengan Ni daripada (2.21) memberi, pada mana-mana titik local (x, y),

Step 3 (b) Strains at the centre(b) Strain pada pusat[3]

At (a/2, b/2) each derivative becomes the average of two side differences:Pada (a/2, b/2) setiap derivative menjadi purata dua beza sisi:

Step 4 (b) Stresses at the centre(b) Stress pada pusat[3]

Answer. (b) σxx = 3.50 × 10³ kN/m² (3.50 MPa), σyy = 549 kN/m², σxy = 0.

Check. σxx is a little above Eεxx = 3333 kN/m², as the physical picture predicted.

Step 5 (c) Displacements at (0.15, 0.3)(c) Displacement pada (0.15, 0.3)[3]

Step 6 (c) Strains and stresses at (0.15, 0.3)(c) Strain dan stress pada (0.15, 0.3)[5]

Answer. (c) u = 1.44 × 10−5 m, v = 2.5 × 10−7 m; σ = {6245, 1374, 481} kN/m² at (0.15, 0.3).

At the centre the same steps givePada pusat langkah yang sama memberi

InterpretationTafsiranIn (b) the displacements are a uniform stretch, so the strains, and the stresses, are the same at every point of the element: the centre is not special there. In (c) the extra movement of node 3 alone makes εxx grow with y and adds a shear strain that grows with x, so the stresses vary inside the element. The element next to it, computed from its own nodes, will give different stresses on the shared side; that is why finite element stresses are usually reported at element centres or averaged at the nodes (Part 3).Dalam (b), displacement ialah regangan seragam, jadi strain, dan stress, sama pada setiap titik dalam element: pusat tidak istimewa di situ. Dalam (c), pergerakan tambahan node 3 sahaja menjadikan εxx bertambah dengan y dan menambah shear strain yang bertambah dengan x, jadi stress berubah di dalam element. Element di sebelahnya, yang dikira daripada node sendiri, akan memberi stress yang berbeza pada sisi yang dikongsi; sebab itulah stress finite element biasanya dilaporkan pada pusat element atau dipuratakan pada node (Part 3).

QuestionSoalanFor concrete with E = 30 × 10⁶ kN/m² and ν = 0.2: (a) calculate [E] for plane stress and for plane strain and compare their entries. (b) A strain state εxx = 2 × 10−4, εyy = εxy = 0 is imposed. Find σxx and σyy in each idealisation, and (c) the out-of-plane stress or strain that each one implies. (d) Which idealisation suits a 200 mm shear wall, and which a long retaining wall?

Physical picture.Gambaran fizikal. Plane stress leaves the faces free, so the material may contract through the thickness; plane strain forbids that, and the slice must be squeezed by a stress σzz. A material that is held in z resists in-plane stretching more, so expect larger normal entries in plane strain. Shear does not change the volume, so the shear entry should be G in both.Plane stress membiarkan muka bebas, jadi bahan boleh mengecut merentasi ketebalan; plane strain melarangnya, dan kepingan itu mesti dihimpit oleh stress σzz. Bahan yang ditahan dalam arah z lebih menahan regangan dalam satah, jadi jangka entri normal lebih besar dalam plane strain. Shear tidak mengubah isi padu, jadi entri shear sepatutnya G dalam kedua-duanya.

Plan. (a) the two factors → the entries → G as a check; (b) {σ} = [E]{ε}; (c) σzz = 0 with εzz from 3D Hooke, or εzz = 0 with σzz = ν(σxx + σyy); (d) geometry.

Step 1 (a) Plane stress(a) Plane stress[3]

Step 2 (a) Plane strain(a) Plane strain[3]

Answer. (a) Plane stress: 31.25, 6.25, 12.5 × 10⁶; plane strain: 33.33, 8.33, 12.5 × 10⁶ kN/m². Plane strain is stiffer in the normal entries; the shear entry G is the same.

Step 3 (b) Stresses for the imposed strain(b) Stress untuk strain yang dikenakan[3]

Step 4 (c) The out-of-plane quantity(c) Kuantiti luar satah[4]

Answer. (c) Plane stress: σzz = 0 and the plate thins, εzz = −5.0 × 10−5. Plane strain: εzz = 0 and σzz = 1667 kN/m² holds the slice at its thickness.

Check. Plane-stress εzz equals −ν/(1 − ν)(εxx + εyy) = −0.25 × 2 × 10−4 = −5.0 × 10−5, the same number by a second route.

Step 5 (d) Choosing the idealisation(d) Memilih idealisation[2]

The shear wall is thin and loaded in its own plane: plane stress. The retaining wall is long with the same section and the same soil pressure along it: plane strain, per metre run.Shear wall itu nipis dan dibebankan dalam satahnya sendiri: plane stress. Dinding penahan panjang dengan keratan dan tekanan tanah yang sama di sepanjangnya: plane strain, per meter panjang.

InterpretationTafsiranThe two matrices differ only where the thickness direction matters. A strain along x alone makes the plane-strain material push back harder (6667 against 6250 kN/m²), and it also produces a larger lateral stress σyy, because the slice can relieve its Poisson effect neither through the thickness nor sideways. For ν = 0.2 the difference is about 7%; for ν = 0.33 it is 12% in bending, and as ν approaches 0.5 the plane-strain entries grow without bound. Choosing the wrong idealisation is therefore a modelling error of known size, not a numerical one: no mesh refinement removes it.Dua matrix itu berbeza hanya di tempat arah ketebalan penting. Strain dalam arah x sahaja menjadikan bahan plane strain menolak balik lebih kuat (6667 berbanding 6250 kN/m²), dan ia juga menghasilkan lateral stress σyy yang lebih besar, kerana kepingan itu tidak dapat melepaskan kesan Poisson-nya sama ada merentasi ketebalan atau ke sisi. Untuk ν = 0.2 perbezaannya kira-kira 7%; untuk ν = 0.33 ia 12% dalam lenturan, dan apabila ν menghampiri 0.5 entri plane strain membesar tanpa had. Memilih idealisation yang salah ialah ralat pemodelan yang saiznya diketahui, bukan ralat berangka: tiada mesh refinement yang dapat menghapuskannya.

Example 3 · Numbering, supports and loads of a plate with a holeContoh 3 · Penomboran, support dan beban bagi plat berlubang

Exam typeJenis soalan node, element and dof numbers; connectivity; known dofs; nodal loads; rigid motionsUnitsUnit symbolicSourceSumber FEM by Hand, Example 9.5 (a), extended15 marksmarkah
QuestionSoalanThe plate of the figure, fixed on its left side and pulled by a uniform traction q (force per unit length, thickness included) on its right side, has a rectangular hole and is modelled by eight four-node elements in three rows of equal height h. (a) Number the nodes, elements and dofs, and give the connectivity of all elements. (b) Which dofs are known, and how many unknowns remain? (c) Write the non-zero entries of the load vector. (d) Show that a small rigid rotation produces no strain, and explain what this requires of the supports.

Physical picture.Gambaran fizikal. The numbering is a choice, but a good one keeps the nodes of each element close in number, so that [K] stays narrow: rows of four nodes from the bottom left do that. The hole only means that some nodes belong to fewer elements and that no element spans it. The left side is held in both directions; the right side is a natural boundary loaded in x; top, bottom and the edges of the hole are free.Penomboran ialah pilihan, tetapi pilihan yang baik mengekalkan nombor node setiap element berdekatan, supaya [K] kekal sempit: baris empat node dari kiri bawah memenuhinya. Lubang itu hanya bermaksud sesetengah node tergolong dalam lebih sedikit element dan tiada element merentasinya. Sisi kiri ditahan dalam kedua-dua arah; sisi kanan ialah sempadan natural yang dibebankan dalam arah x; atas, bawah dan tepi lubang bebas.

Plan. Nodes row by row → elements row by row, skipping the hole → connectivity anticlockwise from the lower left → dofs 2i − 1, 2i → supports → edge loads → rigid motions.

Step 1 (a) Nodes, elements and dofs(a) Node, element dan dof[3]

Nodes 1–4 along the bottom, then 5–8, 9–12 and 13–16 above them. Elements 1–3 form the bottom row, 4 and 5 lie beside the hole, 6–8 form the top row.Node 1–4 di sepanjang bawah, kemudian 5–8, 9–12 dan 13–16 di atasnya. Element 1–3 membentuk baris bawah, 4 dan 5 terletak di sebelah lubang, 6–8 membentuk baris atas.

Step 2 (a) Connectivity(a) Connectivity[4]

elementelement12345678
local 1local 11235791011
local 2local 223468101112
local 3local 36781012141516
local 4local 4567911131415

Check. Every element lists four distinct nodes anticlockwise from its lower left; nodes 6, 7, 10 and 11 at the corners of the hole each belong to three elements, not four, because the hole takes the fourth place.

Step 3 (b) Known dofs(b) Dof yang diketahui[3]

Answer. (b) Dofs 1, 2, 9, 10, 17, 18, 25 and 26 are zero; 24 unknowns remain.

Step 4 (c) Nodal loads from the traction(c) Nodal load daripada traction[3]

Each right-hand edge of height h carries qh, shared equally by its two end nodes in the x-direction; nodes 8 and 12 collect a share from two edges:Setiap tepi kanan setinggi h menanggung qh, dikongsi sama rata oleh dua node hujungnya dalam arah x; node 8 dan 12 mengumpul bahagian daripada dua tepi:

Answer. (c) r7 = r31 = qh/2, r15 = r23 = qh, all in x; nothing in y and nothing elsewhere.

Step 5 (d) Rigid rotation and the supports(d) Rigid rotation dan support[2]

A rigid motion needs no force, so [K] is singular unless the supports prevent both translations and the rotation. Here the fixed left side prevents all three; a support of v alone along it would leave the x-translation and a rotation about the edge free.Rigid motion tidak memerlukan daya, jadi [K] singular melainkan support menghalang kedua-dua translation dan putaran. Di sini sisi kiri yang fixed menghalang ketiga-tiganya; support v sahaja di sepanjangnya akan membiarkan translation x dan putaran terhadap tepi itu bebas.

InterpretationTafsiranThe hole changes nothing in the procedure: its corner nodes simply belong to fewer elements, no element contributes across it, and its edges are free. With rows of four, the node numbers inside any element differ by at most 5, so in [K] (32 × 32) every non-zero entry KIJ has |I − J| ≤ 2 × 5 + 1 = 11: a half-bandwidth of 12 instead of 32. Numbering column by column instead (four columns of four) would give the same here, but on a long plate the rule is to number across the short direction.Lubang itu tidak mengubah apa-apa dalam prosedur: node bucunya hanya tergolong dalam lebih sedikit element, tiada element menyumbang merentasinya, dan tepinya bebas. Dengan baris empat node, nombor node dalam mana-mana element berbeza paling banyak 5, jadi dalam [K] (32 × 32) setiap entri bukan sifar KIJ ada |I − J| ≤ 2 × 5 + 1 = 11: half-bandwidth 12 dan bukan 32. Menomborkan lajur demi lajur (empat lajur empat node) memberi hasil yang sama di sini, tetapi pada plat panjang peraturannya ialah menomborkan merentasi arah yang pendek.

C1 · 2 marksmarkah
A student builds the plane-stress [E] for E = 200 × 10⁶ kN m−2 and ν = 0.25, and uses it for a shear strain εxy = 1 × 10−5. One line contains the slip. Which one?Seorang pelajar membina [E] plane stress untuk E = 200 × 10⁶ kN m−2 dan ν = 0.25, dan menggunakannya untuk shear strain εxy = 1 × 10−5. Satu baris mengandungi kesilapan. Yang mana?

Line 4 then follows the slip; the correct shear stress is 800 kN m−2.Baris 3: entri shear ialah (1 − ν)/2 × E/(1 − ν²) = 0.375 × 213.33 × 10⁶ = 80.00 × 10⁶ kN m−2. Show the codeTunjuk kod · fe_plane_stress.py · 323 linesbaris
"""
SEAA 4243 Finite Element Method - plane stress with 4-node and 8-node elements
==============================================================================

Companion code for the Cantilever and Stress Recovery Explorers (Plane Stress).
It follows the course's steps in the text's notation (Mohd Yassin et al.,
MSNM 2020, Chapter 3):

    [E]   3 x 3 material matrix, plane stress or plane strain       text (3.10)
    [B]   strains from nodal displacements, {eps} = [d]^T[N]{u}     weak form (3.31)-(3.38)
    [k]   = t * integral [B]^T [E] [B] dA                          closed form (3.42);
          here by Gauss quadrature (2 x 2 points for the 4-node
          element, 3 x 3 for the 8-node), which reproduces (3.42)
    loads a uniform traction on the free end becomes consistent nodal
          loads: q b/2 to each node (4-node, (3.45)); q b/6, 2q b/3,
          q b/6 (8-node, (3.51))
    solve assemble (3.46), strike the fixed edge's rows and columns
          (3.48), solve (3.49); reactions from the struck rows;
          stresses {sigma} = [E][B]{u} at any point; principal stresses,
          von Mises, and nodal averaging as in ANSYS.

The built-in problem is the text's cantilever: a plate 4 m x 2 m,
t = 0.01 m, E = 200e6 N/m2, nu = 0.33, fixed at x = 0, loaded at x = 4 by a
uniform downward traction of 5000 N per metre of edge (P = 10 kN in total).
The functions take any L, H, mesh, material, thickness and load.

Mesh and numbering
    4-node: nodes left to right, then bottom to top (the text's 2 x 2 mesh:
    nodes 1-3 along the bottom). dof 2i-1 = u_i, dof 2i = v_i (1-based).
    8-node: corner and mid-side nodes are numbered in the order they are
    created; use node_at(res, x, y) to find a node.

Units
    Any consistent set. The example uses N and m, so stresses come out in
    N/m2 (divide by 1e3 for kN/m2). The traction q is force per unit length
    of the loaded edge (N/m), the thickness already included.

Run
    python fe_plane_stress.py
        reproduces the 2 x 2 cantilever (tip deflection, reactions, stresses
        at (3.5, 1.3)), the convergence of the 4- and 8-node meshes against
        Timoshenko beam theory, and the growth of the stress at the fixed
        corner; saves a von Mises contour plot if matplotlib is installed.

Use for your own model
    from fe_plane_stress import solve_cantilever, stress_at, principal, von_mises
    res = solve_cantilever(L=4, H=2, Nx=8, Ny=4, E=200e6, nu=0.33, t=0.01, q=-5000, nen=8)
    s = stress_at(res, 2.0, 1.3)        # (sxx, syy, sxy)

A hand calculation is still a hand calculation: use this script to check your
matrices and numbers, and to run the mesh study a project needs.
Dense numpy solver: fine up to a few thousand degrees of freedom.

Requires Python 3.8+ and numpy; matplotlib only for the plot.
Course SEAA 4243, Faculty of Civil Engineering, Universiti Teknologi Malaysia.
Code: MIT licence.
"""
import numpy as np


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Material
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def E_matrix(E, nu, plane="stress"):
    """[E] of text (3.10) for plane stress; plane strain when plane = "strain"."""
    if plane == "stress":
        c = E / (1 - nu ** 2)
        return c * np.array([[1, nu, 0], [nu, 1, 0], [0, 0, (1 - nu) / 2]])
    c = E / ((1 + nu) * (1 - 2 * nu))
    return c * np.array([[1 - nu, nu, 0], [nu, 1 - nu, 0], [0, 0, (1 - 2 * nu) / 2]])


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Shape functions in natural coordinates xi, eta in [-1, 1]
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
XI = np.array([-1, 1, 1, -1, 0, 1, 0, -1], dtype=float)
ETA = np.array([-1, -1, 1, 1, -1, 0, 1, 0], dtype=float)


def shape(nen, xi, eta):
    """N (nen,) and dN/dxi, dN/deta (2, nen) of the 4-node or 8-node element."""
    if nen == 4:
        N = 0.25 * (1 + XI[:4] * xi) * (1 + ETA[:4] * eta)
        dN = np.vstack([0.25 * XI[:4] * (1 + ETA[:4] * eta), 0.25 * ETA[:4] * (1 + XI[:4] * xi)])
        return N, dN
    N = np.zeros(8); dN = np.zeros((2, 8))
    for i in range(4):
        cx, cy = XI[i], ETA[i]
        N[i] = 0.25 * (1 + cx * xi) * (1 + cy * eta) * (cx * xi + cy * eta - 1)
        dN[0, i] = 0.25 * cx * (1 + cy * eta) * (2 * cx * xi + cy * eta)
        dN[1, i] = 0.25 * cy * (1 + cx * xi) * (cx * xi + 2 * cy * eta)
    N[4] = 0.5 * (1 - xi ** 2) * (1 - eta); dN[:, 4] = [-xi * (1 - eta), -0.5 * (1 - xi ** 2)]
    N[5] = 0.5 * (1 + xi) * (1 - eta ** 2); dN[:, 5] = [0.5 * (1 - eta ** 2), -eta * (1 + xi)]
    N[6] = 0.5 * (1 - xi ** 2) * (1 + eta); dN[:, 6] = [-xi * (1 + eta), 0.5 * (1 - xi ** 2)]
    N[7] = 0.5 * (1 - xi) * (1 - eta ** 2); dN[:, 7] = [-0.5 * (1 - eta ** 2), -eta * (1 - xi)]
    return N, dN


def B_matrix(nen, a, b, xi, eta):
    """[B] (3 x 2nen) of an a x b rectangle at (xi, eta): rows exx, eyy, gamma_xy."""
    _, dN = shape(nen, xi, eta)
    dx, dy = dN[0] * 2 / a, dN[1] * 2 / b
    B = np.zeros((3, 2 * nen))
    B[0, 0::2] = dx
    B[1, 1::2] = dy
    B[2, 0::2] = dy
    B[2, 1::2] = dx
    return B


def element_stiffness(nen, a, b, Em, t):
    """[k] = t * integral [B]^T[E][B] dA by Gauss quadrature (2 x 2 for Q4, 3 x 3 for Q8)."""
    g, w = np.polynomial.legendre.leggauss(2 if nen == 4 else 3)
    k = np.zeros((2 * nen, 2 * nen))
    for xi, wi in zip(g, w):
        for eta, wj in zip(g, w):
            B = B_matrix(nen, a, b, xi, eta)
            k += t * (a / 2) * (b / 2) * wi * wj * B.T @ Em @ B
    return k


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Mesh
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def mesh(nen, L, H, Nx, Ny):
    a, b = L / Nx, H / Ny
    if nen == 4:
        nodes = np.array([(i * a, j * b) for j in range(Ny + 1) for i in range(Nx + 1)], dtype=float)
        conn = [[j * (Nx + 1) + i, j * (Nx + 1) + i + 1, (j + 1) * (Nx + 1) + i + 1, (j + 1) * (Nx + 1) + i]
                for j in range(Ny) for i in range(Nx)]
        return a, b, nodes, np.array(conn, dtype=int)
    ids, nodes = {}, []
    def node(x, y):
        key = (round(x, 9), round(y, 9))
        if key not in ids:
            ids[key] = len(nodes); nodes.append((x, y))
        return ids[key]
    conn = []
    for j in range(Ny):
        for i in range(Nx):
            x0, y0 = i * a, j * b
            conn.append([node(x0, y0), node(x0 + a, y0), node(x0 + a, y0 + b), node(x0, y0 + b),
                         node(x0 + a / 2, y0), node(x0 + a, y0 + b / 2), node(x0 + a / 2, y0 + b), node(x0, y0 + b / 2)])
    return a, b, np.array(nodes, dtype=float), np.array(conn, dtype=int)


def dofs_of(c):
    return np.ravel([[2 * n, 2 * n + 1] for n in c])


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Solve the cantilever
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def solve_cantilever(L=4.0, H=2.0, Nx=2, Ny=2, E=200e6, nu=0.33, t=0.01, q=-5000.0,
                     nen=4, plane="stress", load="edge"):
    """Fixed at x = 0; vertical load on x = L. load = "edge": uniform traction q (N/m)
    by consistent nodal loads; load = "point": the total q*H at the top-right node."""
    Em = E_matrix(E, nu, plane)
    a, b, nodes, conn = mesh(nen, L, H, Nx, Ny)
    n = len(nodes)
    K = np.zeros((2 * n, 2 * n))
    F = np.zeros(2 * n)
    k = element_stiffness(nen, a, b, Em, t)
    for c in conn:
        d = dofs_of(c)
        K[np.ix_(d, d)] += k                                   # scatter-add by dof map
    if load == "point":
        F[2 * node_at_xy(nodes, L, H) + 1] += q * H
    else:
        for c in conn:
            if np.isclose(nodes[c[1], 0], L):                   # element side 2-3 on the loaded edge
                if nen == 4:
                    F[2 * c[1] + 1] += q * b / 2; F[2 * c[2] + 1] += q * b / 2
                else:
                    F[2 * c[1] + 1] += q * b / 6; F[2 * c[5] + 1] += 2 * q * b / 3; F[2 * c[2] + 1] += q * b / 6
    fixed_nodes = np.where(np.isclose(nodes[:, 0], 0.0))[0]
    known = dofs_of(fixed_nodes)
    free = np.setdiff1d(np.arange(2 * n), known)
    U = np.zeros(2 * n)
    U[free] = np.linalg.solve(K[np.ix_(free, free)], F[free])
    Rk = K[known] @ U - F[known]                               # struck rows: support reactions
    Rx, Ry = Rk[0::2].sum(), Rk[1::2].sum()
    M = sum(-(nodes[nd, 1] - H / 2) * Rk[2 * i] for i, nd in enumerate(fixed_nodes))
    return dict(nen=nen, L=L, H=H, Nx=Nx, Ny=Ny, a=a, b=b, E=E, nu=nu, t=t, q=q, plane=plane, Em=Em,
                nodes=nodes, conn=conn, K=K, F=F, U=U, known=known, reactions=dict(Rx=Rx, Ry=Ry, M=M),
                tip=U[2 * node_at_xy(nodes, L, H) + 1])


def node_at_xy(nodes, x, y):
    return int(np.argmin(np.hypot(nodes[:, 0] - x, nodes[:, 1] - y)))


def node_at(res, x, y):
    """0-based index of the node nearest to (x, y)."""
    return node_at_xy(res["nodes"], x, y)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Stresses
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def locate(res, x, y):
    """Element containing (x, y) and the natural coordinates of the point in it."""
    i = min(res["Nx"] - 1, max(0, int(np.floor(x / res["a"] + 1e-12))))
    j = min(res["Ny"] - 1, max(0, int(np.floor(y / res["b"] + 1e-12))))
    e = j * res["Nx"] + i
    x1, y1 = res["nodes"][res["conn"][e][0]]
    return e, 2 * (x - x1) / res["a"] - 1, 2 * (y - y1) / res["b"] - 1


def stress_in_element(res, e, xi, eta):
    c = res["conn"][e]
    B = B_matrix(res["nen"], res["a"], res["b"], xi, eta)
    return res["Em"] @ (B @ res["U"][dofs_of(c)])


def stress_at(res, x, y):
    """(sxx, syy, sxy) at a global point, from the element that contains it."""
    e, xi, eta = locate(res, x, y)
    return stress_in_element(res, e, xi, eta)


def principal(s):
    """sigma1, sigma2 and the angle (degrees) of sigma1 from x: the Mohr circle."""
    c = (s[0] + s[1]) / 2
    R = np.hypot((s[0] - s[1]) / 2, s[2])
    return c + R, c - R, 0.5 * np.degrees(np.arctan2(2 * s[2], s[0] - s[1]))


def von_mises(s):
    """Plane-stress von Mises stress."""
    return np.sqrt(s[0] ** 2 - s[0] * s[1] + s[1] ** 2 + 3 * s[2] ** 2)


def nodal_stresses(res, mode="averaged"):
    """Stresses at the nodes, as post-processors show them.
    "unaveraged": each element's own value at its nodes, (ne, nen, 3) - jumps visible;
    "averaged":   the mean over the elements sharing each node, (n, 3);
    "centroid":   one value per element, (ne, 3)."""
    nen, conn = res["nen"], res["conn"]
    if mode == "centroid":
        return np.array([stress_in_element(res, e, 0, 0) for e in range(len(conn))])
    un = np.array([[stress_in_element(res, e, XI[i], ETA[i]) for i in range(nen)] for e in range(len(conn))])
    if mode == "unaveraged":
        return un
    n = len(res["nodes"])
    av = np.zeros((n, 3)); cnt = np.zeros(n)
    for e, c in enumerate(conn):
        for i, nd in enumerate(c):
            av[nd] += un[e, i]; cnt[nd] += 1
    return av / cnt[:, None]


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Beam theory for comparison
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def timoshenko_tip(L, H, E, nu, t, q, plane="stress", kappa=5 / 6):
    """Tip deflection magnitude: bending PL^3/(3EI) plus shear PL/(kappa G A)."""
    P = -q * H
    I, A, G = t * H ** 3 / 12, t * H, E / (2 * (1 + nu))
    Eb = E / (1 - nu ** 2) if plane == "strain" else E
    return P * L ** 3 / (3 * Eb * I), P * L / (kappa * G * A)


def plot_von_mises(res, filename="von_mises.png"):
    try:
        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
        from matplotlib.ticker import MaxNLocator
    except ImportError:
        print("matplotlib is not installed: skipping the plot")
        return None
    xs = np.linspace(0, res["L"], 161); ys = np.linspace(0, res["H"], 81)
    X, Y = np.meshgrid(xs, ys)
    Z = np.vectorize(lambda x, y: von_mises(stress_at(res, x, y)) / 1e3)(X, Y)
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 4.6))
    # the fixed corners are singular: cap the colour scale at the 99th percentile
    levels = MaxNLocator(nbins=20).tick_values(0, np.percentile(Z, 99))
    cf = ax.contourf(X, Y, Z, levels=levels, cmap="jet", extend="max")
    ax.set_aspect("equal"); ax.set_xlabel("x (m)"); ax.set_ylabel("y (m)")
    fig.colorbar(cf, ax=ax, label="von Mises (kN/m2)")
    ax.set_title(f"{res['nen']}-node, {res['Nx']} x {res['Ny']} mesh")
    fig.savefig(filename, dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
    plt.close(fig)
    print("saved", filename)
    return filename


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Course examples
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
if __name__ == "__main__":
    np.set_printoptions(precision=4, suppress=True, linewidth=140)
    base = dict(L=4.0, H=2.0, E=200e6, nu=0.33, t=0.01, q=-5000.0)

    r = solve_cantilever(Nx=2, Ny=2, **base)
    print("Text cantilever, 4-node 2 x 2 mesh, (3.44)-(3.49) (nodes 1-3 along the bottom)")
    U = r["U"].reshape(-1, 2)
    for i, (u, v) in enumerate(U):
        print(f"  node {i + 1}: u = {u:+.6f}  v = {v:+.6f} m")
    print(f"  tip deflection = {r['tip']:.4f} m  (text: -0.131)")
    R = r["reactions"]
    print(f"  reactions: Rx = {R['Rx']:.1f} N, Ry = {R['Ry']:.1f} N, M = {R['M']:.1f} N m  (10 kN up, 40 kN m)")
    s = stress_at(r, 3.5, 1.3) / 1e3
    s1, s2, th = principal(s)
    print(f"  stress at (3.5, 1.3) = {np.round(s, 1)} kN/m2  (315.2, -44.9, -310.9)")
    print(f"  principal {s1:.1f}, {s2:.1f} kN/m2 at {th:.1f} deg; von Mises {von_mises(s):.1f}  (494.4, -224.1; 636.8)")

    bend, shear = timoshenko_tip(**base)
    print(f"\nConvergence of the tip deflection; Timoshenko beam {bend:.3f} + {shear:.3f} = {bend + shear:.3f} m")
    for nen, meshes in ((4, [(2, 1), (2, 2), (4, 2), (8, 4), (16, 8), (32, 16)]), (8, [(2, 1), (4, 2), (8, 4), (16, 8)])):
        for Nx, Ny in meshes:
            rr = solve_cantilever(Nx=Nx, Ny=Ny, nen=nen, **base)
            print(f"  {nen}-node {Nx:2d} x {Ny:<2d} dofs {rr['U'].size:5d}  tip {rr['tip']:.4f} m")

    r8 = solve_cantilever(Nx=16, Ny=8, nen=8, **base)
    print(f"\n8-node 16 x 8: sxx(2.0, 1.3) = {stress_at(r8, 2.0, 1.3)[0] / 1e3:.1f} kN/m2 (beam theory 900);"
          f" sxx(3.5, 1.3) = {stress_at(r8, 3.5, 1.3)[0] / 1e3:.1f} (beam 225: end effect, St-Venant)")

    print("\nFixed corner: sxx at the centroid of the top-left element grows with every refinement (a singularity)")
    for Nx, Ny in ((8, 4), (16, 8), (32, 16)):
        rr = solve_cantilever(Nx=Nx, Ny=Ny, **base)
        print(f"  4-node {Nx} x {Ny}: {stress_at(rr, rr['a'] / 2, 2 - rr['b'] / 2)[0] / 1e3:.0f} kN/m2")

    plot_von_mises(r8, "von_mises_q8_16x8.png")

Not counted toward progress.Tidak dikira dalam kemajuan.

plane stressA thin body loaded in its own plane: σzz = σxz = σyz = 0, while εzz may be non-zero.Badan nipis yang dibebankan dalam satahnya sendiri: σzz = σxz = σyz = 0, manakala εzz boleh bukan sifar.
plane strainA long body with every section loaded alike: εzz = 0, and σzz = ν(σxx + σyy) develops.Badan panjang dengan setiap keratan dibebankan sama: εzz = 0, dan σzz = ν(σxx + σyy) terbentuk.
displacement u, vThe movement of a point along x and along y; the primary unknowns of plane stress.Pergerakan satu titik dalam arah x dan y; primary unknown bagi plane stress.
normal stress · shear stressσxx, σyy act normal to a face; σxy = σyx act along it (N m−2).σxx, σyy bertindak normal kepada muka; σxy = σyx bertindak di sepanjangnya (N m−2).
body force fForce per unit volume acting inside the body, N m−3; self-weight fy = −ρg.Daya per unit isi padu yang bertindak di dalam badan, N m−3; berat sendiri fy = −ρg.
differential elementA small rectangle dx × dy on which equilibrium is written before the size goes to zero.Segi empat kecil dx × dy tempat equilibrium ditulis sebelum saiznya menghampiri sifar.
equilibrium equations(3.4) and (3.6): the stress gradients balance the body force in x and in y.(3.4) dan (3.6): stress gradient mengimbangi body force dalam arah x dan y.
operator matrix [∂]The 2 × 3 matrix of derivatives in [∂]{σ}ᵀ = −{f}; its transpose gives the strains.Matrix derivative 2 × 3 dalam [∂]{σ}ᵀ = −{f}; transpose-nya memberi strain.
constitutive matrix [E]The 3 × 3 matrix of Hooke’s law, {σ}ᵀ = [E]{ε}ᵀ; different for plane stress and plane strain.Matrix 3 × 3 bagi Hooke’s law, {σ}ᵀ = [E]{ε}ᵀ; berbeza untuk plane stress dan plane strain.
Young’s modulus E · Poisson’s ratio νStiffness in uniaxial tension; lateral contraction per unit axial strain.Kekakuan dalam tegangan uniaxial; pengecutan sisi per unit axial strain.
shear modulus GG = E/(2(1 + ν)); the (3,3) entry of [E] in both idealisations.G = E/(2(1 + ν)); entri (3,3) bagi [E] dalam kedua-dua idealisation.
engineering shear strain εxy∂u/∂y + ∂v/∂x, the change of a right angle (γxy in many books); twice the tensor shear strain.∂u/∂y + ∂v/∂x, perubahan sudut tegak (γxy dalam banyak buku); dua kali tensor shear strain.
strain–displacement relation{ε}ᵀ = [∂]ᵀ{u}ᵀ: three strains from two displacements.{ε}ᵀ = [∂]ᵀ{u}ᵀ: tiga strain daripada dua displacement.
traction bForce per unit area on the boundary, bx = σxxnx + σxyny, by = σxynx + σyyny.Daya per unit luas pada sempadan, bx = σxxnx + σxyny, by = σxynx + σyyny.
natural · essentialNatural: a known traction, entered as a load. Essential: a known displacement, imposed on the assembled system.Natural: traction yang diketahui, dimasukkan sebagai beban. Essential: displacement yang diketahui, dikenakan pada assembled system.
free edgeA natural condition with zero traction; the finite element model does nothing there.Natural condition dengan traction sifar; model finite element tidak buat apa-apa di situ.
rigid-body motionTranslation or rotation without strain; supports must remove all three in 2D or [K] is singular.Translation atau putaran tanpa strain; support mesti menghapuskan ketiga-tiganya dalam 2D, jika tidak [K] singular.
reactionForce at a support, recovered after solving from the struck rows of the system.Daya pada support, diperoleh selepas menyelesaikan daripada baris sistem yang dibuang.
degree of freedom (dof)One nodal unknown; node n owns U2n−1 (x) and U2n (y).Satu nodal unknown; node n memiliki U2n−1 (x) dan U2n (y).
shape-function matrix [N]The 2 × 8 matrix with {u v}ᵀ = [N]{û}ᵀ; the same Ni for u and for v.Matrix 2 × 8 dengan {u v}ᵀ = [N]{û}ᵀ; Ni yang sama untuk u dan v.
strain-displacement matrix [B][B] = [∂]ᵀ[N], 3 × 8, so that {ε}ᵀ = [B]{û}ᵀ; built in Part 2.[B] = [∂]ᵀ[N], 3 × 8, supaya {ε}ᵀ = [B]{û}ᵀ; dibina dalam Part 2.
stiffness matrix [k][k] = t∫[B]ᵀ[E][B] dA, 8 × 8 for the four-node element; the analogue of the conductance matrix.[k] = t∫[B]ᵀ[E][B] dA, 8 × 8 bagi four-node element; analog bagi conductance matrix.
